insights.text: I was watching players have an extra orb during the Zilyana warp out in P1- if you spam quick enough, you're able to smuggle one into the next phase saving plenty of time for Phase 2 and 3. Just seeing Phase 3 is now skippable which is great! Thanks for the tip. My 25 raids in search for the scim got a little faster :P
